dedupe_keys.name: spatial sampling framework for dental facilities riyadh

description: Talal Alshihayb and colleagues publish a field-validated inventory and sampling materials for private dental facilities in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The July 2026 archive contains de-identified facility records, district geometry, calibration counts, validation and quality-control tables, plus R and SAS code. The README reports 876 surveyed private health facilities, of which 732 provide dental services. Data are freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0 and code under MIT. Facility coordinates and district counts can inform spatial healthcare-access simulations or survey-sampling experiments. Restricted district population is omitted, preventing reproduction of population-standardised outputs from this package alone. Survey dates and remaining coverage uncertainty require checking the study documentation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the census. It is an upstream input to a separate Riyadh transport-access model. Neither facility files nor analysis code were downloaded or executed.
